successful_cancel_concurrency.supports: live six-host successful-cancel overlap; not a successful-cancel C8 throughput measurement

limitations: Fixture execution markers prove one execution for these six same-key recovery scenarios, not universal distributed exactly-once execution.
No host reboot, power loss, WAN partition, ownership transfer, or external-effect deduplication experiment is claimed.
Mac signal identity is account/PID-start best effort; Linux evidence uses pidfd.
Native response files and embedded remote files are independently hashed; argument hashes are checked for shape but full request bodies were not retained in this report.
